chunks: We shall strike terror into the hearts of unbelievers for ascribing compeers to God for which He has sent down no sanction. Hell is their residence, the evil abode of the unjust.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of shirk for disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological and spiritual consequence of *shirk*, where the lack of divine authority (*sultan*) in polytheistic beliefs leads to inner turmoil and terror. It serves as a precursor to the final judgment, emphasizing that the unjust (*zalimin*) will find Hell to be their ultimate abode, a theme resonating with the concept of *adl* (divine justice) where actions dictate eternal destiny.
